input: Project database target of the active project (story_parts, story_covers read only through the table module qnc-program-db) and the qnc-player-input reader of the active workspace for every clip of the story.
output: The flat program playlist (qnc-program-playlist) and the prepared player input of every clip in it. Segments follow each other in stored order; covers go to the segments they overlap; the A1 source channel of a segment and the A2 source channel of a cover come from the database; the picture follows playback.input and the sound is the original; the output channel count is the project audio.channels. Missing facts end in an error, never in a stand-in. load_program_window / window_loader: a program window [in, out) (frames from 0) with a transient cover (source from its IN, cover picture and A2 channel 1) replacing the stored covers of the window; never written (v5 Sync preview).
